headword: {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}
gloss: Hyakunin Isshu; one hundred poems by one hundred poets

definitions.gloss: Hyakunin Isshu; anthology of one hundred poems by one hundred poets
definitions.explanation: A classical Japanese anthology of one hundred waka poems, each by a different poet, compiled by Fujiwara no Teika in the 13th century. Also refers to the traditional card game based on these poems.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We play Hyakunin Isshu at New Year's.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I memorized all one hundred poems of the Hyakunin Isshu.

notes:
Literally "⟦{百|ひゃく}{人|にん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧ (one hundred people) + {一|いっ}{首|しゅ} (one poem each)." The most famous collection is the {小倉|おぐら}{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}, compiled by {藤原|ふじわら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定家|ていか} around 1235. The poems span from the 7th to 13th centuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play Hyakunin Isshu (card game)
- {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧: Hyakunin Isshu cards
- {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to memorize the hundred poems
- ⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}: competitive Hyakunin Isshu

THE CARD GAME:
Played with two sets of cards: {読|よ}み{札|ふだ} (reading cards with the full poem) and {取|と}り{札|ふだ} (grabbing cards with only the second half). A reader recites the first half, and players compete to grab the matching card. Competitive karuta (⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧) is a serious sport with national championships.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally played during ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year's). Many Japanese students learn some of these poems in school. The manga and anime 'Chihayafuru' popularized competitive karuta among younger generations.
